faq.q: How long does a website take?
faq.a: Most websites take 2–4 weeks from brief to launch. A landing page can be ready in about a week.

faq.q: Do I need my own domain?
faq.a: No problem if you don't have one yet — I'll help you choose and set it up.

faq.q: Can I edit the website myself?
faq.a: Yes. I can add an easy admin panel so you can change text and images without touching code.

faq.q: What do you need from me?
faq.a: Your logo (if you have one), some photos and a few words about your business. I can help with the rest.
50% to start, 50% at launch. For larger projects we can split it into more parts.

faq.q: Why are prices shown in my currency?
faq.a: The site detects your region and converts my prices (set in South African rand) at today's exchange rate. The final quote is confirmed after the brief.

about.heading: Design with *purpose.*
about.intro: I'm Edwin Dol — an independent website designer helping brands and small businesses look as good online as they are in real life.
about.body:
I believe a great website should do more than look good — it should help your business grow. I combine clean design, smooth user experience and solid code to build sites that feel effortless to use.

Working alone means you always talk directly to the person designing your site. No account managers, no hand-offs — just fast, honest collaboration.

When I'm not designing, you'll find me exploring new design trends, gaming, or sketching ideas for the next project.

values.title: Clarity

values.text: Spacing, type, motion — the small details that make it feel premium.

values.title: Results
